title: [Solved] Netflix doesn't render in Google Chrome with hardware acc
body: As the message says, Google Chrome (proprietary) doesn't render Netflix videos if hardware acceleration is turned on. The video runs with audio but stream is completely blank. Runs okay if acceleration is off but of course it's poor performance. I have an NVIDIA discreet graphics and it seems the problem could be with it. My laptop doesn't have the same issue. Any help? Would a clean reinstall of chrome deleting all the cache and configuration help? Am I missing some kind of configuration? Running on KDE Wayland. Last edited by d_fajardo (2026-10-20 20:24:06)
